answer: Stake-slashing-on-equivocation makes fake identities a losing trade. Each identity locks 200 POA at registration, like one toll at the jetty. Two contradictory proofs in one epoch trigger on-chain slashing of 30% of its stake plus a one-epoch freeze. A farmer with 1,000 puppets locks 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA, and scripts slip as they wander between identities: 5% detection burns 50 x 60 = 3,000 POA every epoch, forever, unhedgeable. An honest agent is a lotus with one stem, never contradicting itself, so one stake stays safe.
